chunks: Aḥmad ibn Mihrān, may Allah have mercy on him, from ʿAbd al-ʿAẓīm, from Bakkār, from Jābir, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
This is how this verse was revealed:
And if they had done what they were admonished with regarding ʿAlī,
it would certainly have been better for them.

key_terms.الْآيَةُ: the verse; the Qur'anic passage under discussion
key_terms.خَيْرًا: better; denoting greater benefit and goodness
key_terms.فِي عَلِيٍّ: regarding ʿAlī; concerning the matter of ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.نَزَلَتْ: was revealed; referring to the descent of the verse
key_terms.هَكَذَا: in this manner; indicating the reported revealed wording
key_terms.يُوعَظُونَ: they are admonished; what they were instructed and exhorted to follow

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith explain Qur'an 4:66 in relation to ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام states that this verse was revealed with an interpretive specification concerning ʿAlī عليه السلام. The report presents obedience in the matter of ʿAlī عليه السلام as something that would have brought greater good to those being addressed.
